title: CAPS Wrappers Normative Artifact
description: Recipe table for redirect-wrapper detection and unwrap. Consumed by browser-extension cleaners (which detect and unwrap locally) and by the muga-unwrap Privacy Proxy Worker (which uses hostPatterns as an allowlist for what hosts it will fetch on the user's behalf).

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. MUST NOT be reused once published.

hostPatterns.description: Array of either lowercase exact hostnames OR regex source strings. A regex source string MUST start with `^` and end with `$` so consumers can detect and compile it as a full-host anchored pattern.

pathPrefix.description: Optional pathname prefix the wrapper lives under (e.g. `/cread.php`). When present, consumers MUST require url.pathname to start with this string before treating the URL as a wrapper.

notes.description: Audit context: source of the recipe, rationale, gotchas. Required for traceability.

addedIn.description: SemVer of the wrappers.json publication where this entry first appeared.
